hero.supportingLine: For agency partners and search-dependent businesses across MENA and North Africa.

method.title: From evidence to a checked fix
method.intro: SEO work should be reviewable. Each recommendation connects what we found to why it matters, what should change, and how the result will be checked.

steps.title: Evidence
steps.body: Start with the page, crawl, search result, or business constraint that shows the issue.

steps.title: Reason
steps.body: Explain the effect on discovery, understanding, trust, or conversion before proposing work.

steps.title: Action
steps.body: Define a bounded change that an owner, partner, or developer can review before it ships.

steps.title: Verification
steps.body: Recheck the same signal after the change and record what improved, what did not, and what comes next.

example.label: Illustrative finding — not a client result
example.signal: Several important pages are not linked from a clear service path.
example.reason: Search engines and visitors may struggle to understand which pages matter and how the offer fits together.
example.action: Define one route and one intent per page, then add contextual internal links.
example.verification: Crawl the updated site and confirm every priority page is reachable through the intended path.

offer.title: Start with a paid SEO audit
offer.body: Agree the scope first. The audit turns observed issues into a prioritised plan, with a reason and a verification step attached to each recommendation. Price, timing, and deliverables are confirmed before work begins.
points: A defined scope instead of an open-ended engagement
Findings written for decision-makers and implementers
A clear route from audit to pilot or ongoing delivery

verticals.title: Built around how each market is found
verticals.intro: The method stays consistent. The search journey, constraints, and commercial action change by market.

items.label: Dubai property
items.title: Search visibility for a high-consideration local market
items.body: Connect technical foundations, location signals, service intent, and enquiry paths for property businesses competing across areas and languages.

items.label: Algerian e-commerce
items.title: Search structure for catalogue and category growth
items.body: Shape crawlable catalogue paths, useful category pages, and content priorities around how Algerian buyers discover products.

partner.title: SEO for agencies without hidden work
partner.body: SEO for agencies should keep the method visible to the team: scoped work, documented reasons, review points, and verification before reporting.
points: White-label delivery that respects the client relationship
Clear handoffs for strategy, content, design, and development teams
English, French, and Arabic delivery planned as reviewed work — not machine-published copy
